historical_record.description: The building held a nonconforming grocery store and three dwelling units, which the owner proposed to replace with an eight-unit apartment building.

The City Planning Commission unanimously declined to review the permit for an eight-unit apartment building in place of the corner grocery and three flats, though the Telegraph Hill Dwellers wanted the store kept.
